messages.subject: Michelin Thailand | APAC sustainability, responsible industry and stakeholder leadership
messages.body:
Dear Michelin Thailand and APAC Leadership Team,

I am reaching out because Michelin's regional footprint, manufacturing base and sustainability agenda create a strong intersection with my experience in responsible industrial development and stakeholder leadership.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My work spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate affairs, executive communications and cross-functional governance. I routinely connect senior leadership with regulators, communities, industry partners and internal operating teams.

I would bring Michelin an operator's view of sustainability. My recent work includes external and governance support around a large solar and battery-storage platform at a remote mine, carbon-data readiness using physical operational records, community and social-performance coordination, and regulatory engagement across numerous public institutions. The common thread is converting commitments into evidence, ownership and trusted relationships.

I am interested in Thailand, ASEAN or APAC responsibilities across sustainability, corporate affairs, stakeholder engagement, strategic partnerships or responsible business. My attached Michelin-focused executive CV sets out this fit in more detail. I would appreciate your forwarding this note to the appropriate regional executive or talent leader.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
